evidence: Cic. Phil. 2.56: in forō āleā lūdere (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: ālea is the game of dice; Lewis & Short has lūdere āleā or āleam.

sources: Lewis & Short: alea
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 52.
